docs(guidance): compact guidance for agents (experiment)

## Intent

The creator guidance is long and written for people, and an agent carries it through every turn. Try a radically shorter variant written for agents, with every rule and step kept, and test it before main changes.

## Key changes

- Headings of one to three words, bullets, no prose, no reasons for humans, no repetition.
- SKILL.md files are an index of links to references/ loaded on demand; llms.txt lists the must-read files first.
- Every rule (77, same ids, scopes and severities), task, checkpoint and command stays.
- Hard rules where the evals found weaknesses: tick every box, competencies as Ich-kann-Sätze, the content guide grepped for placeholders, no create before the yes, at most two questions per message, a typing game is interactive.
- The content guide's top comment no longer contains the placeholder marker. The rule page joins wrapped list items.

chore(experiment): point all URLs to the branch

## Intent

The agent in the experiment must never read main's guidance, but the guidance, the CLI and a generated app all point to main.

## Key changes

- Every raw URL, create/update/check command and skills install in the guidance, skills, llms.txt, the content guide skeleton and the generator's plan-template hint names exp/compact-guidance instead of main.
- guidance/experiment-prompt.md is the creator's first prompt, with all must-read URLs.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Revert this commit before anything of the branch is merged.
